notes.title: Arrivée de Show Quiz sur Steam !
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575202/205e2bd462b71f4c78dbe5badd33e7008555e32e.png

Hear ye! Hear!
I'm proud to be able to publish Show Quiz on steam! 
Scheduled for release in 2025. 

What's coming out: 

 5000+ questions to test your knowledge!
 An xp system to unlock new game modes!
 A rank to display your ratio of correct answers to questions asked!
 Game modes based on question difficulty.
 An “infinite” game mode where you'll pass over every question in the game.
 A survival mode where you're only allowed 3 mistakes (infinite time and infinite questions).



But that's not all!
I'm also planning a 2.0 version of the game! 

This version will feature multiplayer. 
However, a paying DLC (5€) will allow those who acquire it to host as many games as they wish.
Joining games will remain free for anyone.

On that note, feel free to wishlist my game to support me. 

Thanks to all those who have helped me make my game a reality so far!
